run_mrqa_evaluation: run the MRQA official evaluation script to compute exact match and F1 scores from predictions
evaluate_predictions: evaluate model predictions against ground truth answers using exact match and F1 metrics
normalize_answer: normalize text answers by lowercasing, removing punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace
calculate_f1_score: calculate the F1 score between a prediction and ground truth answer using token overlap
read_predictions_file: read a JSON prediction file and return a dictionary mapping question IDs to answers
